title: Association Master Policy Changes and the CondoGuard Unit Owner
content:
Underwriting bulletin for the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy: what follows when a condominium association changes its master policy type or its master policy deductible.

**Recording the change.** A change in the association's master policy type or master deductible is recorded from the association's certificate of insurance or its written notice to owners, together with the date the association's change took effect.

**Retired clause.** "When the new master policy type raises the tier's Coverage A minimum above the unit's Coverage A, Coverage A must be raised by a Coverage A change endorsement to at least the new minimum." This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current rule for a Coverage A realignment.

**Association change period.** Coverage A is raised within the association change period that starts on the date the association's change took effect. The period is counted in calendar days from the date the association's change took effect, as recorded on the policy, and an endorsement effective on the last day is on time. The length of the period is the tier's association change period.

**Claims before Coverage A is raised.** Until Coverage A is raised, claims are settled on the Coverage A actually in force, never on the new minimum.

**Nonrenewal for Coverage A below the minimum.** When Coverage A is still below the minimum after the association change period, a notice of nonrenewal with the reason Coverage A below minimum is issued at least the tier's nonrenewal notice days before expiration, and it is rescinded once Coverage A reaches the minimum before the expiration date.

**A higher master deductible.** A higher master deductible changes nothing on the unit policy by itself: an assessment passing on the master deductible is still paid only up to the tier's deductible assessment sublimit.

## Timeline illustration (hypothetical dates, 30-day period)

| Date | Event | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 10 June | the association's change takes effect | the period starts |
| 10 July | the last day of the period | an endorsement effective on this day is on time |
| 11 July | the day after the last day | an endorsement effective on this day is after the period |

A claim for a loss on 20 June, while Coverage A is still below the new minimum, is settled on the Coverage A then in force.

superseded_clauses: When the new master_policy_type raises the tier's Coverage A minimum above the unit's coverage_a_limit, Coverage A must be raised by a coverage_a_change endorsement to at least the new minimum.
